name: immich-mcp
description: Austrian efficiency for Immich photo management with FastMCP 2.11+. 25+ tools including library management (external folders), multi-user support, and v2.4.0+ compatibility. Search photos with AI, OCR in 12+ languages.

tools.name: upload_photos
tools.description: Upload photos to Immich with batch processing and metadata detection

tools.name: search_photos
tools.description: Search photos using CLIP smart search, OCR text search, or metadata queries

tools.name: get_photo_info
tools.description: Get complete metadata and EXIF information for a specific photo

tools.name: organize_photos_by_date
tools.description: Automatically organize photos into date-based albums

tools.name: delete_photos
tools.description: Delete photos with trash/permanent options

tools.name: create_album
tools.description: Create a new album with optional assets and description

tools.name: add_to_album
tools.description: Add photos to an existing album

tools.name: list_albums
tools.description: List all albums with metadata and statistics

tools.name: share_album
tools.description: Generate public share link for album

tools.name: detect_people
tools.description: Run face detection on photos and return clustering results

tools.name: tag_person
tools.description: Assign name to detected person/face cluster

tools.name: search_by_person
tools.description: Find all photos containing specific person

tools.name: get_storage_info
tools.description: Get storage usage statistics and performance metrics

tools.name: backup_photos
tools.description: Export photos for backup with metadata preservation

tools.name: server_health
tools.description: Check Immich server health and connection status

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List all Immich libraries for external folder management

tools.name: get_library_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Immich library

tools.name: create_library
tools.description: Create a new library for organizing external photo folders

tools.name: scan_library
tools.description: Scan library for new photos from external folders

tools.name: add_library_location
tools.description: Add external folder path to an Immich library

tools.name: remove_library_location
tools.description: Remove external folder path from library

tools.name: manage_library
tools.description: Perform maintenance operations on libraries (optimize, refresh, clean)

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List all configured Immich users for multi-user support

tools.name: switch_user
tools.description: Switch between different Immich user accounts

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get information about the currently active user

tools.name: get_user_libraries
tools.description: Get libraries accessible to a specific user

immich_server_url.title: Immich Server URL
immich_server_url.description: The base URL of your Immich server (e.g., http://localhost:2283 or https://immich.example.com)

immich_api_key.title: Immich API Key (Legacy)
immich_api_key.description: Single-user API key for backward compatibility. For multi-user setup, use IMMICH_USERS instead.

immich_active_user.title: Active User
immich_active_user.description: Which user to use by default (must match a user in IMMICH_USERS)

log_level.title: Logging Level
log_level.description: Logging verbosity level (debug, info, warning, error, critical)
